events.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you handle sorting the donated tools and labeling the boxes by type? If that’s okay, I’ll check the list and confirm the drop-off details.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes by type. Let me know the drop-off details when you have them.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — let me just double-check the details first, and I’ll confirm with you soon.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Great, thanks — can you let me know as soon as you confirm?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’ll let you know what needs doing.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll wait for your update and then I’ll confirm the details.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll sort out the details and get back to you soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces too — did they manage to fix the fence by the corner?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — I’ll check on the details and let you know once I confirm.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces myself. If you find out whether the fence got fixed, just let me know and I can pass it along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, Noah — I’ll confirm everything once I have them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — just let me know when you’ve got the details and I’ll keep an eye out.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Hana: Will do — I’ll update you as soon as I’ve confirmed everything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m keeping the repair tasks aligned with the school pickup window, and I’ve got Gus’s tools lined up too. If you can spare a hand when we start, that would help a lot.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I can help, but please send me the start time and which tasks you want me on so I can confirm.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — I’ll send the start time as soon as I lock it in, and I’ll put you on the first repair tasks. Your help would be a big boost.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the start time and task details, then I’ll confirm what I can take on.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll swing by after my errands and check what still needs doing. I should be back around mid-afternoon, and I’ll let you know if that changes.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — mid-afternoon works for now, and I’ll wait for your update before I confirm anything else.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, Bo — I’ll confirm everything once I have them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Bo: No rush — just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the confirmed details as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Hana: I’m still on for it — just send me the start time and I’ll be there. If there’s a first task for me, I’m happy to take it on.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Faye: Great — I’ll check our school pickup timing and send you the start window so we can line it up. If you’re ready, I’ll point you to the first fix when we get there.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Hana: Sounds good — just confirm the start window when you have it, and I’ll take the first fix.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Hana: Mid-afternoon still works for now, and I’ll wait for your update before I confirm anything else.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll send an update if anything changes on my end.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for your update and hold mid-afternoon for now.
events.speaker: Hana
